title: MonitoringConfig
description: Runtime source of truth for the Guided Portfolio Watch Skill. Written to ALFS at ~/feeds/gpw-monitor/v1/config.json. Read by gpw-monitor and gpw-fundamentals feed scripts at cloud runtime.

tickers.description: US-listed equity or ETF symbols, uppercase. Source of truth for what both feeds monitor.

holdings.description: Per-ticker ownership classification. Affects alert prose language only.

horizon.description: Investment horizon. Controls alert policy and preferencesNote framing.

guidanceMode.description: Communication preference, inferred from user intent. Not a claim about expertise. guided = plain language + definitions. standard = financial terminology accepted. neutral = accessible but not condescending.

weights.description: Optional illustrative allocation weights (user-provided scenario; not verified live data). Values are fractions (0–1). Sum must be 1.0 ± 0.02.

sectorFocusAreas.description: Per-ticker one-sentence monitoring focus, derived from sector/industry at setup time. Never invented — uses generic fallback if sector unknown.

preferencesNote.description: Assembled prose passed verbatim to @alva/portfolio-watch as portfolioWatchPreferencesNote. Built deterministically from the other fields; never LLM-generated.

rejectedTickers.description: Symbols from user input that were rejected (crypto, options, non-US format, common-word blocklist). Stored for transparency; not used by feed scripts.

weightsNormalized.description: True if user-provided weights were normalized because they did not sum to exactly 1.0.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this config was first created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this config was last modified.
